# Tacet motion spec

Status: v1, 2026-09-27. Owner: margin/design.
Sources: [DESIGN-GUIDE.md](../DESIGN-GUIDE.md) §2.7 and §4, [tokens.json](../tokens.json) `motion`, [ANIMATION-GATE.md](../ANIMATION-GATE.md) (owner-supplied, 2026-09-27), [FIRST-BOOT.md](../FIRST-BOOT.md) §6.

**The spec is the law; the videos are feel references.** Every reference clip in [assets/motion/](../assets/motion/) was generated by an image-to-video model (Kling 3.0 Pro or MiniMax H3) from two accepted keyframes. Those models work at 24 fps (one frame = 41.7 ms), cannot hold a 100 or 160 ms duration, cannot guarantee a curve, and sometimes re-render text. Use them to judge *what moves and what stays still*, never to measure timing. Numbers below come from the guide and tokens; where the owner's gate disagrees with the guide, the conflict is listed in §3 with a proposal, and the gate-compliant value is marked **(gate)**.

Vocabulary (tokens.json `motion`, plus the gate's names):

| Name | Value | Where it comes from |
| --- | --- | --- |
| instant | 0 ms | tokens `duration.instant` |
| quick | 100 ms | tokens `duration.quick` |
| base | 160 ms | tokens `duration.base` |
| gentle | 240 ms | tokens `duration.gentle` |
| exit | 70% of enter (base exit = 110 ms) | tokens `rules.overlayExit` |
| standard | `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` | tokens `easing.standard` |
| enter | `cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0, 1)` | tokens `easing.enter` |
| exit curve | `cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 1, 1)` | tokens `easing.exit` |
| spring / drawer | `cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)` | tokens `easing.spring` = gate `--ease-drawer` (identical) |
| gate ease-out | `cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)` | gate; used for the mark and icons only (see §3, G6) |

Properties: `transform` and `opacity` only (gate). No `width`, `height`, `top`, `filter` or color transitions except the hover color/fill changes the guide already specifies at quick.

## 1. The motions

### M-01 Mode switch: Write, Read, Code

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Frequency (gate) | Tens a day; often by keyboard (Ctrl+Alt+1/2/3). |
| Purpose | State indication. |
| Document content | **instant (0 ms).** No crossfade, no caret glide, no reflow animation (tokens `rules.never`). Write and Read share metrics, so no character moves (M3). Code swaps the view in one frame. |
| Segmented thumb (guide §4.5) | `transform: translateX(<segment offset>)`, base 160 ms, spring `(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)`; labels never animate; label weight swaps at the start (segments are fixed width). **(gate)** Only when the switch is made with the pointer. Keyboard switches move the thumb instantly. |
| `Write ▾` picker (REFERENCES-V2 C3, if adopted) | No thumb. The label text swaps instantly. The picker menu follows M-03 (menu). |
| Reduced motion | Thumb jumps (0 ms). |
| Reference | [mo-01-mode-switch.mp4](../assets/motion/mo-01-mode-switch.mp4) (Kling 3.0 Pro, job `8111c749`). What to see: the page is identical before and after; only the thumb moves and the caret disappears. The clip's thumb move is slower than 160 ms. |

### M-02 Shelf open and close

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Frequency (gate) | Tens a day, often by keyboard (Ctrl+B / Ctrl+Alt+B). |
| Purpose | Spatial consistency (where the shelf lives). |
| Shelf | Pointer: the shelf slides in as a whole, `transform: translateX(-240px -> 0)` on the shelf layer, gentle 240 ms, drawer `(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)`; close = exit 170 ms, exit curve. Rows are already laid out and never animate separately; shelf content does not fade (tokens `rules.shelf`). Keyboard: instant **(gate)**. |
| Page and text column | **Column anchoring (proposed, G2):** if the text column's current screen x still leaves at least 32 px between the shelf edge and the column when the shelf opens, the column keeps its screen x and nothing on the page moves. Only when it would collide does the column move, in the same 240 ms drawer transition, `transform: translateX`. The page never reflows (the column width is capped). |
| Title bar | The title group sits over the page and moves with the shelf edge in the same transition (guide §4.2). |
| Reduced motion | Instant open and close. |
| Reference | [mo-02-shelf-open-close.mp4](../assets/motion/mo-02-shelf-open-close.mp4) (Kling 3.0 Pro, job `e3f6b683`, ping-pong loop). What to see: the page edge travels, the heading and paragraph do not move at all. That is the column-anchoring behavior. Rejected: the MiniMax take (shelf rows slide in with the edge). |

### M-03 Overlays: palette, menus, title menu, dialogs, toasts

| Overlay | Frequency | Enter | Exit | Reduced motion |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Command palette and file finder (Ctrl+P, Ctrl+Shift+P) | 100+ a day | **instant (0 ms) (gate)**. Guide §4.19 value was opacity + 4 px rise, base 160 ms, enter curve: kept only as the fallback if the owner rejects G1. Results never animate. | instant **(gate)**; guide value opacity 110 ms exit curve | instant |
| Context menus, Alt menu | tens a day | opacity 0 -> 1, 120 ms, enter curve (guide §4.20), no scale | opacity, 80 ms, exit curve | opacity only (already) |
| Title menu (popover under the document title) | occasional | opacity 0 -> 1 + `scale(0.97 -> 1)`, 160 ms, enter curve, `transform-origin` at the title button (gate: popovers grow from their trigger) | opacity, 110 ms, exit curve | opacity only, 100 ms |
| Find widget | tens a day | opacity + `translateY(-4px -> 0)`, 160 ms, enter (guide §4.15) | opacity 110 ms | opacity only |
| Dialogs (Discard Draft, unsaved changes) | occasional | scrim opacity 0 -> 1 and dialog opacity + `scale(0.97 -> 1)`, 200 ms, enter curve, centered | opacity 140 ms, exit curve | opacity only, 100 ms |
| Toasts | rare | opacity + `translateY(8px -> 0)`, 160 ms, enter (guide §4.22) | opacity 110 ms | opacity only |
| Tooltips | tens a day | opacity, quick 100 ms after the 600 ms delay | opacity 70 ms | same |

Reference: [mo-03-palette-arrive.mp4](../assets/motion/mo-03-palette-arrive.mp4) (MiniMax H3, job `548fb38f`, ping-pong). It shows the guide-era arrival (fade and a small rise, results present on arrival, page not dimmed). With G1 accepted, the palette simply appears; keep the clip as the reference for "the page behind never moves or dims". Rejected: the Kling take (the frame arrives empty and results stream in, which breaks "results never animate").

### M-04 Caret

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Frequency | Always on screen while writing. Not a response animation. |
| Blink | `editor.cursorBlinking: "phase"`: opacity fade, 1060 ms cycle (tokens `caretBlink`). Solid while typing; the blink restarts 500 ms after the last keystroke (upstream behavior). |
| Glide | `editor.cursorSmoothCaretAnimation: "explicit"`: glides only on jumps the user asked for (Ctrl+Home, search result). Never while typing, never on mode switch. |
| Rich editor | `--md-cursor-background` accent; same phase blink via the webview's CSS (`@keyframes` opacity, 1060 ms, ease-in-out). |
| Reduced motion | Blink stays (it is not spatial) but follows the Windows cursor blink rate; if Windows blink is off, the caret is solid. No glide. |
| Reference | [mo-04-caret-phase.mp4](../assets/motion/mo-04-caret-phase.mp4) (Kling 3.0 Pro, job `d1434f1c`). Soft fade, not a hard blink. |

### M-05 Save state in the footer

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Frequency | Tens a day (autosave, Ctrl+S). |
| Purpose | State indication (M5). |
| Change | Word swap `Edited` -> `Saving…` -> `Saved` as an opacity crossfade, quick 100 ms, standard curve. Fixed 160 px slot, so nothing shifts. `Saving…` only if the save takes more than 400 ms. No check mark, no color (Saved is not an achievement). |
| Failure | `Couldn't save` appears the same way in danger text and stays; the notice (M-06) carries the detail. Nothing flashes. |
| Reduced motion | Instant swap. |
| Reference | [mo-05-save-state.mp4](../assets/motion/mo-05-save-state.mp4) (MiniMax H3, job `ac202ab2`, ping-pong). What to see: one word crossfades in place; nothing else changes. |

### M-06 File notices (read-only, changed on disk, save failed)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Frequency | Rare. |
| Purpose | Preventing a jarring change + state indication. |
| Enter | Notice opacity 0 -> 1, base 160 ms, enter curve. **(gate, G3)** The document below moves down by the notice height in one step at the start (no animated height). Guide §4.24 value was "expand height, gentle"; height is not a transform and would scroll the text the user is reading. |
| Exit | opacity 110 ms, then the document moves up in one step. |
| Reduced motion | Instant. |
| Reference | none (static: [c04](../assets/concept-v2/hf/c04-notice-changed.hf.v2.png), [c05](../assets/concept-v2/codex/c05-notice-savefailed.codex.v3.png)). |

### M-07 First boot: the page clears

Values in [FIRST-BOOT.md](../FIRST-BOOT.md) §6: setup content opacity out 110 ms (exit curve), 40 ms empty page, then title-bar controls + `Start writing.` + caret opacity in 160 ms (enter curve). 310 ms total, no movement, input never blocked. Reference: [mo-06-fb-page-clears.mp4](../assets/motion/mo-06-fb-page-clears.mp4) (MiniMax H3, job `9a65c9f0`). What to see: the window and the column position never change; only words fade.

### M-08 Tacet mark (rare tier)

Values and code in [assets/animated/](../assets/animated/) (`margin-mark.css`, `ANIMATED-IDENTITY.md`): pen-stroke draw 880 ms (launch splash variant 560 ms), caret wink 600 ms, page nod 720 ms. Reduced motion: 200 ms fade, no draw.

### Small state motions (tens a day, near-imperceptible)

| Element | Motion |
| --- | --- |
| Hover fill and color | quick 100 ms, standard. Color changes stay under reduced motion (capped at 80 ms). |
| Focus ring | appears instantly (a delayed focus ring hides where focus is). Guide §2.7 said quick; **(gate)** instant is safer for keyboard users. |
| Pointer-down fill | instant. |
| Twistie chevron | `rotate(0 -> 90deg)`, quick 100 ms, standard. |
| Checkbox tick | `opacity` + `scale(0.9 -> 1)`, 100 ms, gate ease-out; unchecking instant. Done text dims at quick. |
| Scrollbar | fade in quick, fade out 800 ms after scrolling stops (upstream). |
| Sash hover line | appears after 300 ms hover delay, opacity quick. |

## 2. Reduced motion, in one place

Trigger: `workbench.reduceMotion: "on"`, or `"auto"` with Windows "Animation effects" off (`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`). Effect: every `transform` transition and keyframe becomes 0 ms. Opacity changes stay but at 0 to 100 ms (tokens `$description`: 0 to 80 ms; use 80 ms as the cap for anything above). The caret blink follows the Windows blink setting. The first boot and all mark animations become a 200 ms fade or instant.

## 3. Conflicts found (proposals for the owner; the guide is not edited)

| # | Guide / tokens say | Gate says | Proposal |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| G1 | Palette enters base 160 ms with a 4 px rise (§4.19, tokens `overlayEnter`) | Command palette is 100+ a day: no animation | Palette and file finder appear and disappear instantly. Keep 160 ms for occasional overlays only. |
| G2 | Shelf: "the text column recenters with the available width" (§2.7) | "The page never moves" | Column anchoring (M-02): keep the column's screen x when there is room; move it only on collision. This is also the stricter reading of M3. |
| G3 | Notice: "expand height gentle" (§4.24) | transform/opacity only; nothing being read moves for style | Opacity fade; the document shifts once, unanimated. |
| G4 | Focus ring appearance quick 100 ms (§2.7) | none stated | Instant focus ring. |
| G5 | Mode switch "instant" but thumb slides 160 ms (§2.7, §4.5) | Keyboard shortcuts never animate | Thumb slides only for pointer input; keyboard switches are instant. Moot if the `Write ▾` picker (REFERENCES-V2 C3) replaces the segmented control. |
| G6 | Enter curve `(0, 0, 0, 1)` | `--ease-out (0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)` | Keep tokens `enter` for workbench overlays (already implemented against it); use the gate curve for the mark, icons and the first-boot webview. Pick one before R2 ships, then fold it into tokens.json. |

## 4. UI-KIT surfaces (single source for the engineering port)

[UI-KIT.md](../UI-KIT.md) (coordinator decision, 2026-09-27) maps every surface to an Animate UI component. This table restates its motion with exact values in this file's vocabulary, so the port reads one place. Where UI-KIT and the rows above disagree, the **Port value** column is what to build; the last column says why and what the owner still has to confirm. Reduced motion for every row: transforms off, opacity at most 80 ms (§2) unless stated.

| Surface | Animate UI source | Tier | Port value | Reduced motion | Notes / conflicts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Title menu | `base/popover` | O | Enter: opacity 0 -> 1 + `scale(0.96 -> 1)`, `transform-origin` at the title button, 180 ms, gate ease-out `(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)`. Exit: opacity + scale to 0.98, 120 ms, exit curve. | opacity 80 ms | Supersedes M-03's 160 ms title-menu row (UI-KIT wins; both pass the gate). |
| Mode picker `Write ▾` | `base/menu` | O | Menu enter 160 ms from the trigger, opacity + `scale(0.97 -> 1)`, gate ease-out; items not staggered. Choosing a mode: document swap instant (M-01). Keyboard (Ctrl+Alt+1/2/3): no menu, no motion. | opacity 80 ms | |
| Context menus, Alt menu | `base/menu` | O | Enter 150 ms from the pointer point, opacity + `scale(0.97 -> 1)`, gate ease-out; exit 100 ms opacity. | opacity 80 ms | Guide §4.20 said 120 ms fade, no scale: UI-KIT wins. |
| Document title dirty dot | custom (UI-KIT row) | F | Dot enter: opacity + `scale(0.6 -> 1)`, 120 ms, gate ease-out, on the first edit after a save; leave: opacity 100 ms. | instant | Never animates while typing continues (only on the state change). |
| Title hover/focus state text | `texts/morphing` | F | `Saved` <-> `Edited` swap in the title tooltip: 180 ms morph (opacity crossfade + letter morph), only on hover/focus. | opacity crossfade 80 ms | If the morph ever runs while the user types, drop it to a plain crossfade (gate 4). |
| Shelf open/close | `radix/sidebar` | O | UI-KIT: 220 ms drawer `(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)`, width + opacity. **Port:** animate `transform: translateX` of the shelf layer and clip, not `width`; shelf content does not fade (tokens `rules.shelf`); keyboard toggle instant. Column anchoring per M-02. | instant | Conflict: UI-KIT says width + opacity; gate says transform/opacity only and tokens say content never fades. Proposal: transform-only, as written. |
| Shelf sections | `base/accordion` / `collapsible` | O | Expand/collapse 180 ms, height auto via `grid-template-rows: 0fr -> 1fr` (layout, exempted because content below moves with intent), gate ease-out; chevron `rotate(0 -> 90deg)` 100 ms. | instant | Height animation is a documented exception to transform-only; confirm with the owner. |

| Pinned notes | `primitives/animate/pinned-list` | O | Pin/unpin: the row moves to its new slot with a 200 ms `transform` layout animation (FLIP), drawer curve. | instant | Only on pin/unpin, never on sort or load. |
| Tooltips | `base/tooltip` + `animate/tooltip` | F | 600 ms delay (300 ms between adjacent), enter opacity + `translateY(4px -> 0)` 125 ms gate ease-out; moving between adjacent triggers: the bubble glides (shared layout) 125 ms; exit 80 ms. | opacity only | |
| Dialogs | `base/alert-dialog`, `base/dialog` | O | Backdrop opacity 150 ms; dialog opacity + `scale(0.97 -> 1)` 200 ms gate ease-out, centered; exit 140 ms exit curve. | opacity 80 ms | Matches M-03. |
| Toasts | `community/notification-list` pattern | O | Enter and exit through the same (bottom) edge: `translateY(8px -> 0)` + opacity, 250 ms gate ease-out; exit 175 ms. | opacity 80 ms | Guide §4.22 said 160 ms: UI-KIT wins. |
| Checkbox (settings, dialogs) | `base/checkbox` | F | Tick path draws 160 ms gate ease-out (stroke-dashoffset; a documented exception to transform-only, it is the tick itself); press `scale(0.97)` 100 ms; uncheck instant. | tick appears instantly | Supersedes the 100 ms tick in §1 small motions. |
